info.name: whatAppseller REST API
info.description:
whatAppseller Dual-Channel REST API (port 8002)

Three user roles: Client, Merchant, Admin
Phone number = identity. Verified via WhatsApp OTP.

## Quick Start
1. `POST /api/auth/request-otp` â†’ sends OTP via WhatsApp
2. `POST /api/auth/verify-otp` â†’ returns JWT access + refresh tokens
3. Set `access_token` and `refresh_token` collection variables
4. All authenticated endpoints use Bearer token

## Auth Flow
- Access token: 15 min expiry
- Refresh token: 30 days, stored in Redis
- `POST /api/auth/refresh` â†’ new access token

## Roles
- **client**: Browse, search, express interest
- **merchant**: Manage products, view dashboard, subscription
- **admin**: Full dashboard (separate admin endpoints on port 8001)

item.name: Chat
item.description:
Single conversational endpoint.

Send text and/or images. The system handles:
- Greeting -> welcome text
- Help -> instructions
- Product description -> searches + returns results with result_code
- Image upload -> visual search
- RS- code -> recalls previous search
- 'my last search' -> fetches most recent result

Response includes reply_type, response_text, result_code (for search_results), and sections.

formdata.value: I need red Nike sneakers under 150k UGX
formdata.description: Natural language message (optional if files attached)
Optional product images to search by

request.description:
Single conversational endpoint for the frontend chat.

On success, returns reply_type='search_results' with:
- result_code (e.g. RS-A3K2) - share with a merchant
- response_text - conversational summary
- sections - matching products with images, prices, merchant details

Supports lat/lng for location-aware distance calculations.

formdata.description: Enter an RS- code to recall a previous search

request.description:
Recall a previous search by typing its RS- code.
Returns the original search context: query, category, sample products, etc.

formdata.description: Phrases like 'my last search' or 'like before' trigger recall

request.description:
Recall the most recent search result. Detects phrases like:
- 'my last search'
- 'show me my previous results'
- 'the one from before'

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints. Phone number = identity.
OTP sent via WhatsApp, expires in 5 minutes.
Rate limited: 3 OTPs per phone per 15 minutes.

request.description:
Send a 6-digit OTP to the given phone number via WhatsApp.

Rate limited: max 3 requests per phone per 15 minutes.
Returns 400 for invalid phone format, 429 for rate limit.

Verify OTP code and get JWT tokens.

Creates a new user if phone not registered.
Returns 401 for wrong/expired code, 403 if banned.

Replace `code` with the actual 6-digit OTP received via WhatsApp.
Set `role` to `client` or `merchant`.

Verify OTP for a merchant account.
Set role to `merchant` to create/access a merchant identity.

Get a new access token using refresh token.
Refresh tokens are valid for 30 days.
Returns 401 if refresh token is revoked or expired.

item.name: Search
item.description:
AI-powered visual search endpoints.
All search endpoints require client authentication.
Search history is automatically recorded in Redis.

request.description:
Search for similar products by uploading an image.

Pipeline: YOLO detection â†’ SigLIP+DINOv2 embedding â†’ Qdrant ANN â†’ reranker

Optional filters: lat/lng for proximity, price_min/price_max for budget.
Max file size: 10MB.

exec: console.log('  - ' + r.name + ' | ' + r.price + ' ' + r.currency + ' | Score: ' + r.score);

request.description:
Search for products using a text description.

Pipeline: text embedding â†’ Qdrant ANN â†’ reranker

Query is required. Location and price filters are optional.

Find products near a geographic location.
Uses PostGIS spatial queries.

lat and lng are required. km defaults to 10.

Upload multiple images + optional text query.
Returns structured sections with results per image/text.

formdata.value: I need red Nike sneakers under 150k UGX
formdata.description: Natural language description of what you want (required)

request.description:
Search for products by describing what you want in natural language.

Pipeline: NLU intent extraction -> entity parsing -> text embedding -> Qdrant ANN -> reranker

Example descriptions:
- "I need red Nike sneakers under 150k"
- "Looking for a blue dress size medium"
- "Show me affordable electronics under 200k"

item.name: Result Codes
item.description:
Look up customer search result codes.

When a customer searches via Chat, they get a result_code (e.g. RS-A3K2).
They share this with a merchant, who looks it up to see what the customer wants.

No customer identity is revealed - just their search context.

request.description:
Look up a customer's search result code.

Requires merchant auth.
Returns what the customer was searching for - no user identity.

Response includes:
- code: The result code
- search_query: What they typed
- image_description: What was detected in their image
- category, price range
- product_count: How many matches
- sample_products: Up to 3 example product names/prices
- created_at: When the search happened

item.name: Admin Dashboard
item.description:
Admin-only dashboard endpoints (separate API on port 8001).

## Quick Start
1. `POST /admin/seed` â†’ creates the first admin (email: admin@whatappseller.com, password: changeme123)
2. `POST /admin/login` â†’ returns an admin access token
3. Use `{{admin_access_token}}` as Bearer token for all other admin endpoints

Capabilities:
- Analytics: overview, recent merchants, conversation volume
- Merchants: list/detail, suspend, reactivate, ban
- Buyers: list/detail, ban, unban
- Listings: list/detail, deactivate, reactivate
